civil_procedures_checklist.communications: All communications by email to assistant (williamsa@jud14.flcourts.org), subject line with case name/number. Pro se and excused attorneys may call 850-638-6255. No text messages. All parties copied on emails (Canon 3). Assistant not authorized to provide legal advice; strives to respond within one business day.
civil_procedures_checklist.scheduling: Trials set by Court. Motion filer responsible for scheduling. Anticipate >=20 days for hearings >15 min. Request by email to assistant copying opposing counsel with case style, number, motion type, time, first available date, counsel names. Confirmation email required before filing notice. Hearings >1 hour generally in-person; others may be Zoom by agreement. Materials due 3 business days before hearing. Washington County is central time zone. Continuations: 3 business days prior, good cause, disfavored.
civil_procedures_checklist.conferral: Certificate of good faith conferral required before filing any motion except as noted in Rule 1.202. Confer = substantive conversation in person or by telephone; not email/fax/letter. Certificate states date, names, specific results. Movant arranges. Court may sua sponte deny without certificate. Not required for ex parte, uncontested, judgment on pleadings, summary judgment, or other dispositive motions. Motion to dismiss: must confer; upon request, stipulate to curative amended pleading.
civil_procedures_checklist.proposed_orders: Submit via e-filing portal using 'Submit Proposed Order(s) to Judiciary (Court)' option. DJMCA format, .docx, no fill-in blanks, no section breaks. Required service statement at end. Cover letter in .pdf required. Non-compliant orders rejected. Deadline: 14 days after hearing. Pro se excused from email: U.S. mail or hand-deliver.
civil_procedures_checklist.courtesy_copies: Case law courtesy copies at least 3 days prior to hearing/trial. Do not send copies of already-filed documents. Remote proceedings: email assistant 3 days prior to request OneDrive folder access. Physical: mail to 1293 Jackson Avenue, Chipley, FL 32428, at least 7 days prior.
civil_procedures_checklist.remote_appearance: Hybrid virtual courtroom (Rule 2.530). Zoom Meeting ID 575 051 0920; phone 1-312-626-6799. Private location, professional dress, camera on, microphone muted. In-person requests made at scheduling time. Objection to remote: file 14 days prior. Stable internet, charged device with video/sound/microphone.
civil_procedures_checklist.pretrial_conferences: Any party may request CMC or status conference. CMCs encouraged for complex cases; mandatory for attorneys unless excused. Must articulate reasons. Moving party schedules per standard procedures.
civil_procedures_checklist.trial_setting: Court sets trial date. No date-certain trials; cases assigned to specific days during trial period, may assign back-up cases. All parties/witnesses expected available during entire trial period.
civil_procedures_checklist.emergency_matters: Detailed motion with issues, reasons for emergency, time needed. Court schedules unilaterally if emergency exists.
civil_procedures_checklist.forms: Available at https://www.jud14.flcourts.org/forms; additional in Clerk's office.
